text: Kogoro operates a private detective agency after serving as a police officer; his professional identity is important to how he approaches requests.

text: Kogoro’s reputation as the celebrated "Sleeping Kogoro" grew after Conan repeatedly supplied deductions while Kogoro appeared asleep; public acclaim alone does not prove who reasoned out a case.
